Morgan: Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A. How do we practically defend our serving moat against hyperscalers and boutique inference vendors? Looking for concrete, actionable playbook items we can start this quarter.
Asha: Short answer: stack the defense across three layers — performance (latency + cost), operations (rollouts + SLAs), and integrations (KMS, private networking). Will share a 90-day epic.
Asha: Concrete next steps: 1) public, reproducible benchmarks using customer-like workloads; 2) harden Dedicated + Private onboarding (certs, docs, runbooks); 3) ship customer-specific quant/profiler snapshots. Also build a "fallback matrix" mapping model variants to cost/latency tiers. Example canary config: ```canary: {"weight": "5%", "fallback": "redwood-small-8q"}```
Riley: On messaging — should we lead with "predictable unit economics" or "low-latency at scale"? Which angle resonates more with mid-market vs AI-native startups?
Priya: Quick field note from deals — mid-market wants SLOs, contractability, and predictable bills. AI-native startups care more about raw cost and iteration speed. We should keep two front pages.
Diego: Engineering question — how aggressive should Optimize be with quantization suggestions? We risk shipping recommendations that cause subtle quality regressions.
Morgan: Good point. Defaults should be conservative: "suggest" not "auto-apply". Product owns thresholding and a rollback hook in the Console.
Sam: Can leadership name 3 metrics product/marketing should watch to know if our positioning is landing? Want things we can instrument quickly.
Morgan: Three to start: (a) Trial->Paid conversion within 30 days (b) Avg normalized cost per 1k tokens for new accounts (c) Rate of customer-reported quality regressions per quarter. Also track NPS for platform.
Liam: Do we have a formal competitor tracking feed? I can stand up a weekly digest if we want a single source of truth.
Asha: Yes — SalesOps owns the research repo but eng-ml should receive model/perf notes. @Liam please coordinate with @Priya to pull deal-level intel and add a perf column. :thumbsup:
Priya: Will do — I'll share our latest win/loss notes and contract excerpts for the Dedicated deals.
InfraBot: Note: all-hands Q&A notes and the 90-day epic draft uploaded to Confluence — https://confluence.redwood/ah/1708501234
Morgan: Thanks everyone. Action items: Asha to publish 90-day epic, Priya+Liam to start the weekly competitor+perf digest, Sam to add the three metrics to the product dashboard. We'll reconvene on this in the next follow-up sync.
